answer: Let attack cluster size n require super-linear capital c(n)=an^2, while quadratic slashing imposes l(n)=bn^2, and consensus ledge fixes reward pool R as a gale cap. Then marginal attack cost MC=2an plus lotus penalty d n exceeds R/n for n above threshold n0=ceil(R/(2a+2b-d)); beyond it, value extraction is negative and economically impossible.
